scientific_integrity: The equilateral probability constant is previously known from the area-uniform interior-point model (Prékopa, 1972 and Ionaşcu, 2016); novelty concerns the full side-length-dependent perimeter law and its sharp Schur/majorization ordering. Symbolic algebra verifies finite equalities; geometry and general inequalities are proved in the accompanying text.
scientific_limitations: Three i.i.d. Euclidean arclength samples on nondegenerate triangular boundaries, vertex-centroid capture only. Degenerate side proportions are limiting cases only. No claim concerning other sampling laws, polygons, targets or sample counts.
title: Exact centroid-capture probability and sharp shape ordering for uniformly sampled triangle perimeters
